dict.Copac (primul element e rădăcina, sub tr: Tree (the first item is the root, under the trunk; the others are the leaves in the crown, linked to the trunk by branches)
dict.Rădăcina jos, sub trunchi, iar ideile ca: The root at the bottom, under the trunk, and the ideas growing from it in the leaves of the crown (a core idea and what grows out of it)
